sceneDescription: On a bright supermarket checkout belt, a sleek, metallic robotic arm (like from an industrial warehouse) is carefully placing a fresh, flaky croissant onto the conveyor, surrounded by typical grocery items—milk, apples, a gold watch. A small Richemont-branded shopping bag is half-tucked behind the groceries, and a Modern Retail magazine peeks from an open reusable bag. The juxtaposition of advanced tech handling a simple pastry, alongside luxury and everyday objects, creates a playful metaphor for AI-powered retail and luxury’s surprising resilience.
